title: 과거진행 부정문·의문문 (wasn't ~ing / Were you ~ing?)
goal: '~하고 있지 않았어요', '~하고 있었어요?'를 말하고 짧게 대답할 수 있어요.

points.title: 부정문은 wasn't / weren't + -ing
points.body: was 뒤에 not을 붙이면 돼요. was not = wasn't, were not = weren't. I wasn't sleeping.(나는 자고 있지 않았어요)처럼 써요.

points.title: 의문문은 Was / Were를 맨 앞에
points.body: was와 were를 주어 앞으로 보내면 질문이 돼요. You were working. → Were you working?

points.title: Did가 아니라 Was / Were
points.body: -ing가 있는 문장은 Did를 쓰지 않아요. 'Did you sleeping?'이 아니라 'Were you sleeping?'이에요.

points.title: 짧은 대답
points.body: Was로 물으면 was / wasn't, Were로 물으면 were / weren't로 대답해요. Yes, she was. / No, they weren't.

formula: I / He / She / It + wasn't + 동사-ing
Yes, 주어 + was/were. / No, 주어 + wasn't/weren't.

mistakes.why: '~하고 있었니?'는 Did가 아니라 Was/Were로 시작해요. -ing와 Did는 같이 못 써요.

mistakes.wrong: "Was Diane washing her car?" "Yes, she did."
mistakes.right: "Was Diane washing her car?" "Yes, she was."
mistakes.why: Was로 물었으니 대답도 was로 해요. 한국어로는 둘 다 '응'이라 헷갈려요.

examples.en: "Did I wake you?" "No, I wasn't sleeping."
Ken wasn't jogging at 8. He was at home.
examples.ko: Ken은 8시에 조깅하고 있지 않았어요. 집에 있었어요.

examples.en: "Sorry I'm late." "Don't worry. We weren't waiting long."
Nick and Joe weren't eating. They were still looking at the menu.
examples.ko: Nick과 Joe는 먹고 있지 않았어요. 아직 메뉴를 보고 있었어요.

examples.en: "Were you working in LA in 2010?" "No, I was in Seattle."
examples.ko: "너 2010년에 LA에서 일하고 있었어?" "아니, 난 시애틀에 있었어."

examples.en: "Was Diane washing her car when you saw her?" "Yes, she was."
examples.ko: "네가 Diane을 봤을 때 그녀는 세차하고 있었어?" "응, 하고 있었어."

quiz.sentence: Ken ___ jogging at 8. He was at home.
quiz.ko: Ken은 8시에 조깅하고 있지 않았어요. 집에 있었어요.

quiz.sentence: ___ you working on the farm last summer?
quiz.why: you는 Were로 묻고, -ing가 있으면 Did는 못 써요

quiz.ko: 내가 전화했을 때 너 자고 있었어?
quiz.answer: Were you sleeping when I called?
choices: Was you sleeping when I called?
Did you sleeping when I called?
Were you sleeping when I called?
Were you sleep when I called?

quiz.answer: She wasn't waiting for the tram.
choices: She weren't waiting for the tram.
She didn't waiting for the tram.
She wasn't wait for the tram.
She wasn't waiting for the tram.

quiz.ko: "네 하우스메이트들 TV 보고 있었어?" "응, 보고 있었어."
quiz.answer: "Were your housemates watching TV?" "Yes, they were."
choices: "Were your housemates watching TV?" "Yes, they were."
"Were your housemates watching TV?" "Yes, they did."
"Was your housemates watching TV?" "Yes, they was."
"Did your housemates watching TV?" "Yes, they did."
quiz.why: housemates는 여럿이니까 Were로 묻고 were로 대답
